text_sources: A scientist records observations in a notebook and checks each explanation against the evidence. Clear measurements help reveal which parts of a system deserve closer attention.
The train crosses a quiet valley before reaching a city beside the river. Travelers carry maps, books, and small bags while discussing the next stop on their journey.
A teacher explains how fractions describe equal parts of a whole. The students compare examples, write down their reasoning, and check their answers together.
The garden contains apple trees, flowering plants, and a narrow path. After the rain, the gardener examines the soil and decides which beds need attention.
An engineer prepares a controlled experiment with fixed inputs and a clear stopping rule. The results are recorded carefully so another person can reproduce the work.
A library keeps histories, novels, reference books, and collections of poetry. Readers search the shelves and share recommendations with friends at a nearby table.
The cook measures flour and water before mixing the dough. While the bread rises, vegetables are washed and a simple soup is prepared for the evening meal.
A small observatory stands on a hill outside the town. On a clear night, visitors learn how telescopes collect light and why careful calibration matters.
provenance.prompt_construction: Tokenize the corresponding text source without special tokens; cycle its token IDs and take the exact declared prompt length.
provenance.output_construction: Synthetic scheduling replay, not model-generated text: cycle the corresponding source token IDs starting at token offset 17.
provenance.depth_construction: W4 output index 0 has depth 4; index g>=1 has depth 2+((request ordinal+g-1)%3). W5 reuses output IDs and forces every depth to 4.
